steps.calloutText: Whole book under review, with owner assignments, ESDD progress, and risk classification on every row.
steps.narration: The manager view at Laxmi Sunrise Bank. Every loan currently under review is here, with the assigned officer, the ESDD checklist progress, and the risk classification if a screening has been saved. This is what the compliance lead reviews before the credit committee meets each week.

steps.calloutText: Any loan with a 'c' answer in NRB ESRM Annex 5 appears here with the driving questions listed inline.
steps.narration: When any of the officers records a 'c' answer on the NRB ESRM Annex 5 checklist, the loan appears in this escalation banner automatically. The manager clicks a pill to jump into the borrower's screening. There is no separate escalation queue to maintain, and no manual triage step. If the banner is not visible in the current demo state, no loans have hit the escalation trigger yet.

steps.calloutTitle: Compliance status stripe on every loan
steps.calloutText: ESDD chip · Taxonomy chip · escalation callout with driving questions — all inline on the workbench.
steps.narration: The workbench for any single loan shows the compliance state front and centre. ESDD chip on the left with the risk class if a screening has been saved. Taxonomy chip on the right with the classification color and the activity name. If the loan escalated, the driving questions are listed inline so the manager knows exactly what triggered it. no need to open a separate per-question drawer.

steps.calloutTitle: Assign or reassign the loan owner
steps.calloutText: Dropdown assigns the loan to any officer on the tenant's roster. The change appears in that officer's queue on the next refresh.
steps.narration: Right at the top of every workbench sits the ownership control. The manager can assign an unassigned loan to any officer on Laxmi's roster, or reassign an already-owned loan with a single click. The change is recorded to the audit trail and appears in the receiving officer's My Work queue on the next refresh. No email, no ticket, no lost handoff.

steps.calloutTitle: Portfolio roll-up — Green / Amber / Red / Unclassified
steps.calloutText: Every taxonomy classification the officers save rolls up automatically. Amber transitional bucket separated per NRB reporting treatment.
steps.narration: Every taxonomy classification the officers save rolls up automatically into the annual NFRS disclosure view. Four buckets. Green, Amber, Red, Unclassified. with outstanding rupee totals and per-activity breakdown. The Amber transitional bucket is separated on its own terms per NRB's October 2024 reporting treatment. Loans in taxonomy-eligible sectors that haven't been classified yet are flagged so nothing slips through the annual filing.

steps.calloutText: Excel and PDF in NRB submission format, carrying Laxmi Sunrise branding. JSON for downstream systems.
steps.narration: The full classification report exports as Excel or PDF for the NRB submission, or JSON for the bank's own downstream systems. Both file formats carry Laxmi Sunrise's logo, primary color, and display name because the document is being filed by Laxmi, not by us. One click from the manager view to a filing-ready document.
